info.description:
# 🤖 GeM ML Microservice API Documentation (v2.0.0)

Official standalone Postman collection containing strictly the **13 Consolidated Production Endpoints** of the GeM ML Microservice.

### 🚀 Base URLs:
- **Direct ML Production (Azure VM)**: `http://20.40.44.184`
- **Direct ML Local**: `http://localhost:8000`
- **Spring Boot Proxy Gateway (Local)**: `http://localhost:8080/api/officer/tenders`
- **Spring Boot Proxy Gateway (Render)**: `https://sih2026-83r4.onrender.com/api/officer/tenders`

### 🖥️ Interactive Interfaces:
- **Swagger UI**: `http://20.40.44.184/docs`
- **Web Dashboard**: `http://20.40.44.184/ui`

request.description: Endpoint 2: Returns operational health of the microservice and latency checks against Government GST Portal.
Endpoint 3: Retrieves supported procurement document types, field extraction schemas, and compliance scoring weights.
Endpoint 4: Performs OCR text extraction, document classification, statutory entity extraction, QR code decoding, pyHanko signature validation, and OpenCV stamp tampering check.
Endpoint 5: Master Autonomous End-to-End Pipeline executing forensic verification, statutory check, 6-pillar compliance scoring, ML score prediction, and clear/reject verdict.

item.name: 05. Master Multipart Batch File Upload Autonomous Audit

request.description: Endpoint 6: Fully autonomous batch file upload pipeline. Automatically classifies all uploaded PDFs/images, cross-verifies statutory registries, parses tender requirements, and computes composite CIS score.

item.name: 06. Consolidated Single-GET Comprehensive Dossier & RAG Synthesis

request.description: Endpoint 7: Returns unified 360-degree bidder dossier, statutory risk indicators, GFR compliance report, and RAG knowledge retrieval context.
Endpoint 8 (File): Multi-layer forgery detection: ELA analysis, pyHanko digital signature validation, QR code payload validation, and OpenCV official stamp verification.
Endpoint 8 (JSON): Arithmetic and statutory cross-validation for extracted invoice and financial documents.

item.name: 09. Unified Statutory Taxpayer Verification (GSTIN, PAN, UIN)

request.description: Endpoint 9: Statutory taxpayer validation checking checksum algorithms, status (Active/Suspended), filing track record, and risk flag computation.
Endpoint 10: NLP entity parsing to extract financial criteria, technical experience requirements, and mandatory document checklists.
Endpoint 11: Automated final procurement verdict (CLEARED, CONDITIONALLY_CLEARED, REJECTED, ESCALATED_FOR_MANUAL_AUDIT) with immutable audit hash.

item.name: 12. Direct ML Compliance Verdict & Score Predictor

request.description: Endpoint 12: Machine learning classification model predicting probability of tender compliance.
Endpoint 13: Triggers retraining pipelines for document classifiers, risk scoring models, and compliance predictors.
